mapper.select: SELECT P.MEM_ID, M.MEM_NICKNAME, M.MEM_BIR, P.PROFILE_PHOTO, P.PROFILE_HEADERPHOTO, P.PROFILE_INTRO, P.PROFILE_URL, P.PROFILE_POSTCNT, P.PROFILE_FRIENDCNT FROM PROFILE P JOIN MEMBER M ON P.MEM_ID = M.MEM_ID WHERE P.MEM_ID = #{memId}
SELECT POST_INDEX, MEM_ID, POST_CN, POST_PHOTO, POST_REG_DT FROM POST WHERE MEM_ID = #{memId} ORDER BY POST_REG_DT DESC
